verdict.rationale: Cooley's global offices page lists its own offices in the US, China and Hong Kong, Singapore, the UK and Belgium. Its patent and trademark practice pages describe in-house teams spanning the US, UK and Europe, so a founder expanding abroad can stay with the same firm. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of the international footprint and explicit statements of local-law corporate qualification in each non-US office.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm states its own offices or qualified practices in multiple countries, so expansion does not immediately mean a second firm

citations.quote: In addition to our 19 international offices, we maintain strong practices ... in several key markets.
Cooley's global patent team includes 100+ lawyers and professionals across the US, UK and Europe
Cooley's international trademark, copyright and advertising team – 35+ lawyers and paralegals, one of the largest groups among AmLaw 50 firms – spans the US, UK and Europe
